evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships
that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: A mandatory gate is justified as protecting the collective from prior harm — security and fairness to the wider system co-occur.
The gate is framed as a security requirement — conservation of system integrity.
Extending the gate across all environments appeals to comprehensive security coverage.

mints.name: GateAsCollectiveSafeguard
mints.title: the whole reason for the gate
mints.frame: Is the control here justified as protecting the collective from a named prior failure, rather than as individual preference or rank?
